description.fun: Rhyhorn has a tiny brain and a one-track mind: once it starts running, it forgets why, and just keeps going until it falls asleep. Its short legs mean it can only charge in straight lines, so it smashes through anything in its way, and may only feel the pain the next day. Its bones are said to be a thousand times harder than a human's.
description.guide: A grey, rhinoceros-like Ground and Rock Pokémon covered in rocky plates, with a horn on its snout. It can only charge in straight lines and smashes through obstacles. It evolves into Rhydon and then Rhyperior.
description.tagline: A rocky rhino that forgets why it's running

description.fun: Standing on two legs, Rhydon can topple buildings with a swipe of its tail, and its drill-like horn bores through solid rock and shatters diamonds. Its armoured hide lets it wade through magma and shrug off a cannonball, but leaves it a bit insensitive, and for all its brains it can be forgetful. In the code of the original games, its index number is 001.
description.guide: The middle stage of Rhyhorn's line, a large, bipedal Ground and Rock Pokémon with a drill-like horn and an armoured hide that protects it from heat and blows. It was designed with a kaiju motif. It evolves into Rhyperior when traded holding a Protector.
description.tagline: A kaiju-style rhino whose horn shatters diamonds

description.fun: Rhyperior fires rocks from holes in the palms of its hands, loading them in like cannonballs, and now and then it fires a Geodude or Roggenrola by mistake. Its shell can survive volcanic eruptions and can't be scratched even by a masterwork sword. It's stronger than Rhydon, though its brain is smaller.
description.guide: The final stage of Rhyhorn's line, introduced in Generation 4, a huge Ground and Rock Pokémon with a drill horn, rocky armour plates and holes in its palms through which it fires rocks. It evolves from Rhydon when traded holding a Protector.
description.tagline: A living rock cannon that sometimes loads a Geodude

note.text: The Protector Rhydon holds when traded seems to stay with it: Rhyperior's orange armor plates look much like it.
